900000023.s: The dates auction at Al Fursan Village runs on weekends until 15 November 2026, as part of the AlUla Harvest season.
900000023.b:
The Royal Commission for AlUla is organising the seventh AlUla Dates Season. The auction opened on 18 September at Al Fursan Village and continues on weekends until 15 November 2026.

You can watch traditional harvesting methods such as climbing palm trees with ropes, collecting the date clusters and sorting dates into palm-leaf baskets. AlUla has more than 4.2 million palm trees.

900000015.s: The Abhur seafront area, part of Jeddah Season 2026, is open until 4 November with beach activities, water sports and food kiosks.
900000015.b:
The Abhur area is one of the zones of Jeddah Season 2026, with beach activities, water sports and food kiosks along the Abhur waterfront.

The area is open now and runs until 4 November 2026.

900000016.s: A real estate, construction and urban development exhibition from 15 to 17 October in Madinah.
900000016.b:
A specialised exhibition for real estate, construction and urban development in the western region, bringing together building-materials suppliers, contractors and engineering offices.

It runs from 15 to 17 October 2026 at the King Salman International Convention and Exhibition Center, with sessions and workshops on investment and sustainable construction.
900000016.a: King Salman International Convention and Exhibition Center, Madinah

900000017.t: Play: The Station Does Not Leave 2
900000017.s: A theatre performance at the Taif Culture and Arts Association from 15 to 17 October 2026.
900000017.b:
The Taif Culture and Arts Association presents the play The Station Does Not Leave 2, the stories of characters whose paths cross at a symbolic train station as they face their fears and the decisions they have put off.

From Thursday 15 to Saturday 17 October 2026. Tickets from SAR 30.
900000017.a: Taif Culture and Arts Association, Taif

900000006.s: The Riyadh racing season starts on 16 October 2026 at King Abdulaziz Racetrack and runs until 17 April 2027.
900000006.b:
The 2026-2027 Riyadh racing season begins on Friday 16 October at King Abdulaziz Racetrack and runs to 17 April 2027, with races on Fridays and Saturdays.

Total prize money for the season is SAR 197.8 million. New this year are the Riyadh Crown series for locally bred horses and the Riyadh Sword series for imported mares.

900000001.t: Riyadh Season 2026 Kicks Off: Big Time
900000001.s: The seventh edition of Riyadh Season starts on Wednesday 21 October 2026 and runs until 1 March 2027 under the slogan Big Time.
900000001.b:
His Excellency Turki Alalshikh, Chairman of the General Entertainment Authority, announced that Riyadh Season 2026 starts on Wednesday 21 October. This is the seventh edition of the season, and its slogan is Big Time. The season runs until 1 March 2027 and includes tournaments, concerts, theatre and comedy shows, and events for families and children.

Announced zones include Boulevard World, which adds pavilions for the Netherlands, Portugal and Yemen this year, Boulevard City, Wonder Garden, The Groves, the Farmers' Market, the I Am Arab exhibition at Via Riyadh, Al Suwaidi Park and Al Dirah.

Opening dates for each zone and entry prices will be published on the season's official platforms as they are announced.

900000027.s: Nine days of sport and wellbeing in AlUla: a half marathon, a 24-hour endurance race, a duathlon, yoga and cinema under the moon.
900000027.b:
The AlUla Wellness Festival returns from 23 to 31 October 2026 as part of the AlUla Moments calendar, spread across AlUla's valleys, oases and heritage sites.

The programme includes the AlUla Half Marathon (21.1, 10, 5 and 1.5 km), a 24-hour endurance race (solo or teams), the AlUla Duathlon, the Wadi Ashar Challenge (paddling, cycling and swimming), a nine-day yoga programme, a cycling camp with the Jayco AlUla team, and VOX Cinemas moonlight screenings.

Many activities require advance registration, and it is advisable to book accommodation early.
900000027.a: Multiple locations in AlUla: valleys, oases, heritage sites and resorts

900000012.t: Black Coffee in Jeddah – In Act
900000012.s: An electronic music night with DJ Black Coffee at Onyx Arena in Jeddah on 23 October.
900000012.b:
MDLBEAST presents a concert in its In Act series by South African DJ Black Coffee, joined by DISH DASH and BKR B2B RDJ.

Friday 23 October 2026 at Onyx Arena, near King Abdulaziz Airport. Gates open at 6 pm. The event is for ages 18 and over, and tickets start from SAR 405.

900000021.s: A small-group walking tour exploring the geology of Hegra, every Saturday from 24 October to 12 December 2026.
900000021.b:
As part of the AlUla Moments calendar, the Hegra Geology Walking Tour runs every Saturday from 24 October to 12 December 2026.

Places are limited. The tour introduces you to Hegra's rock formations and their geological history. Early booking is available on the Experience AlUla website.

900000028.s: The tenth Future Investment Initiative, titled The Power of Legacy, takes place in Riyadh from 26 to 29 October.
900000028.b:
Riyadh hosts the tenth Future Investment Initiative (FII10) under the patronage of the Custodian of the Two Holy Mosques, titled The Power of Legacy.

The conference brings together heads of state, company chiefs and investors to discuss the global economy, technology and sustainability. The organisers confirmed that the conference is going ahead as scheduled.

Attendance is by advance registration through the initiative's official website.
900000028.a: King Abdulaziz International Conference Center, Riyadh

900000002.s: Marilyne Naaman performs a one-night concert at Teatro Riyadh on Thursday 29 October 2026.
900000002.b:
Lebanese singer Marilyne Naaman performs a one-night concert on Thursday 29 October 2026 at Teatro Riyadh in Granada District.

Doors open at 7:30 pm and the show starts at 9 pm. Tickets start from SAR 325 through Platinumlist.

900000029.t: Taq Sessions – An Evening of Tarab
900000029.s: An evening of tarab and music at The Warehouse in Jax District, Diriyah, where guests may wear the traditional Najdi nashal.
900000029.b:
The Taq Sessions evening of tarab and music takes place at The Warehouse in the Jax creative district in Diriyah, organised by Arab Events in collaboration with @twh_ksa.

The evening starts at 9 pm, with general admission and balcony seat tickets available through Webook. Guests may choose to wear the traditional Najdi nashal.

900000030.t: 88 Keys – A Piano Evening of Tarab
900000030.s: A live 90-minute piano evening blending Arabic and international melodies with singing and lighting, including pieces performed for the first time.
900000030.b:
As part of the Nights of Art series, the 88 Keys evening is a live 90-minute piano performance that combines Arabic tarab and international melodies with singing and stage lighting, and includes new pieces performed for the first time.

The show is on Thursday 29 October at 9 pm at the Hassan Abbas Sharbatly Theatre at the Jeddah Literary Club. Tickets in several categories are available through Webook.
900000030.a: Hassan Abbas Sharbatly Theatre, Jeddah Literary and Cultural Club

900000003.t: Canelo Alvarez vs. Mbilli – Mexico vs. the World
900000003.s: Boxer Canelo Alvarez faces world champion Christian Mbilli for the WBC super middleweight title on 31 October 2026 in Riyadh.
900000003.b:
In an evening called Mexico vs. the World, organised by The Ring magazine and Riyadh Season, Mexican star Canelo Alvarez meets Christian Mbilli in a 12-round fight for the WBC super middleweight title, on a 10-fight card that includes four world titles.

The fight is on Saturday 31 October at The Venue in Riyadh. Tickets on Webook start from SAR 100. General admission is open to ages 6 and over, and VIP categories to ages 16 and over.

900000031.s: A live metal night with the bands Jahim and Maadan in Jax District, Diriyah.
900000031.b:
An evening for fans of metal and heavy rock at The Warehouse in the Jax District in Diriyah, with the bands Jahim and Maadan on stage.

From 9 pm until midnight on Saturday 31 October. General admission tickets, balcony seats and a buy-one-get-one-free offer are available through Webook.

900000010.s: An international motor show in Jeddah bringing together every type of powertrain, from 4 to 7 November 2026.
900000010.b:
Jeddah hosts the Jeddah International Motor Show 2026, bringing cars of every powertrain type together in one place.

It runs from 4 to 7 November 2026 at the Jeddah Superdome, and welcomes visitors from 4 pm to 11 pm.
900000010.a: Jeddah Centre for Forums and Events, Jeddah

900000018.s: Illuminated balloons with music, lighting, fire shows and aerial acrobatics at Hegra on 6 and 7 November, as part of the AlUla Skies Festival.
900000018.b:
The illuminated balloons show takes place at Hegra on 6 and 7 November 2026 as part of the AlUla Skies Festival.

Illuminated balloons are accompanied by music, lighting and light projection, with fire performers and aerial trapeze artists.

900000020.s: Stargazing sessions with five telescopes, a specialist astronomer and an AlUla storyteller, from 7 pm to 11 pm.
900000020.b:
Stargazing sessions at AlUla Fort, part of the AlUla Skies Festival, take place on 6 and 7 November and from 10 to 15 November 2026, from 7 pm to 11 pm.

There are five telescopes, and a trained astronomer leads the session alongside a storyteller from AlUla who tells stories of the sky and the place.

900000013.s: Comedian Nimr Abu Nassar performs his show Standing! at Dar Al-Hekma University in Jeddah on 7 November.
900000013.b:
Lebanese comedian Nimr Abu Nassar performs his stand-up show Standing! in Jeddah on Saturday 7 November 2026.

At Dar Al-Hekma University. Doors open at 8:30 pm and the show starts at 9 pm. It is for ages 18 and over, and tickets start from SAR 150.

900000004.s: Riyadh hosts WWE Crown Jewel on Saturday 7 November 2026 at 10 pm at the Riyadh Season Stadium in KAFD.
900000004.b:
WWE Crown Jewel returns to Riyadh as part of Riyadh Season 2026 on Saturday 7 November, starting at 10 pm at the Riyadh Season Stadium in the King Abdullah Financial District (KAFD).

Tickets will be released on Webook. Follow the official announcement for sale dates and prices.

900000005.t: Cat Show and Dog Village in Riyadh
900000005.s: The Cat Show and Dog Village, part of the Saudi Pet and Veterinary Exhibition, from 9 to 11 November 2026 in Riyadh.
900000005.b:
The Riyadh International Convention and Exhibition Center hosts the Cat Show and Dog Village, part of the Saudi Pet and Veterinary Exhibition, from 9 to 11 November 2026.

The exhibition is open daily from 3 pm to 10 pm. Cat Show tickets start from SAR 75, and Dog Village from SAR 65.
900000005.a: Riyadh International Convention and Exhibition Center, Riyadh

900000019.t: Illuminated Balloons Show at Elephant Rock
900000019.s: An illuminated balloons show at Elephant Rock on 13 and 14 November with music, lighting and fire performances.
900000019.b:
Elephant Rock hosts the illuminated balloons show on 13 and 14 November 2026, on the final days of the AlUla Skies Festival.

Illuminated balloons, music, light projection, fire shows and aerial acrobatics, with Elephant Rock as the backdrop.

900000034.s: An Italian jazz evening in which Fabio Liberati reinterprets famous Italian songs in a jazz style.
900000034.b:
As part of the Yalla Jazz series, Italian artist Fabio Liberati and his Pausa Caffè Italian Jazz Project present an evening of well-known Italian songs rearranged with a jazz spirit.

The show is on Friday 13 November from 9:00 to 10:20 pm at The Warehouse in Jax District. Tickets are through Webook: general admission SAR 200 and balcony seats SAR 250. Children under 6 are not admitted.

900000035.s: The region's largest real estate exhibition, bringing together developers, financiers and homebuyers in Mulhim from 16 to 19 November.
900000035.b:
Cityscape Global returns in 2026 with leading real estate developers, giga-projects and financing providers from across the Kingdom.

The exhibition is open daily from 12 noon to 10 pm, and VIP visitor card holders get early entry.

It is a chance to explore housing and real estate investment projects and financing solutions in one place.
900000035.a: Riyadh Exhibition and Convention Center, Mulhim, north Riyadh

900000037.s: The final event of the International Series golf swing, with top Asian Tour players at Riyadh Golf Club.
900000037.b:
Riyadh hosts the PIF Saudi International, supported by SoftBank, the final tournament of the Asian Tour's International Series, on the courses of Riyadh Golf Club.

The competition runs over four days from 18 to 21 November 2026, with general admission tickets and hospitality packages available through the official website.

900000038.t: Longines Global Champions Tour GC Playoffs Show Jumping Finals
900000038.s: The finals of the Longines Global Champions Tour show jumping series return to Riyadh for four days of competition.
900000038.b:
The GC Playoffs show jumping finals return to Riyadh after the 2024 edition, featuring the Super Grand Prix of the Longines Global Champions Tour and the GCL Super Cup of the Global Champions League.

The competition runs for four days with the world's elite riders. Tickets and the detailed schedule have not yet been released, and you can register for notifications on the organisers' website.

900000014.t: Mohamed Helmy – Plus One Stand-Up Show
900000014.s: Comedian Mohamed Helmy performs his Arabic show Plus One at Dar Al-Hekma University in Jeddah on 26 and 27 November.
900000014.b:
Comedian Mohamed Helmy performs his show Plus One in Arabic in Jeddah over two nights, Thursday 26 and Friday 27 November 2026.

At Dar Al-Hekma University. Gates open at 8:30 pm and the show runs from 9 to 10:30 pm. Tickets start from SAR 287.50.

900000040.s: The region's largest cybersecurity event, bringing together experts, companies and ethical hackers in Mulhim.
900000040.b:
The Black Hat MEA conference and exhibition returns from 1 to 3 December 2026 in Mulhim, north of Riyadh.

It includes technical sessions, an exhibition of cybersecurity companies, capture-the-flag (CTF) hacking competitions and networking opportunities for professionals and students.

Tickets and registration are through the event's official website.
900000040.a: Riyadh Exhibition and Convention Center, Mulhim, north Riyadh

900000007.t: Asian Indoor and Martial Arts Games Riyadh 2026
900000007.s: Riyadh hosts the sixth Asian Indoor and Martial Arts Games from 13 to 21 December 2026.
900000007.b:
The Games take place from 13 to 21 December 2026 under the Olympic Council of Asia.

They feature 18 sports, including taekwondo, wrestling, karate, boxing, jiu-jitsu, judo, weightlifting, chess, padel and 3x3 basketball. The main venue is Boulevard City, with seven halls.

900000008.t: Jeddah E-Prix 2026 – Formula E Season Opener
900000008.s: The Jeddah Corniche Circuit opens the 13th Formula E season with two night races on 18 and 19 December.
900000008.b:
Jeddah opens the 13th season of the Formula E World Championship, the first season with Gen4 cars, with two rounds on the Jeddah Corniche Circuit.

Both races are held at night under floodlights on a 3 km circuit with 19 turns. Tickets are available through Webook.

900000022.s: The first international edition of the Ultra Gobi races outside China, with desert endurance races from 30 to 400 km in AlUla.
900000022.b:
AlUla hosts the Ultra Gobi race from 13 to 20 January 2027, the first edition of this series outside China.

The categories are a 400 km solo non-stop race with a 139-hour limit, a 121 km race in three formats, a one-day 30 km race with an overnight stay in a desert camp, and a 90 km family race over three days.
